edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The purchase price for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”) shall be the amount agreed in writing by the parties before signing. No Purchase Price is agreed under this draft.

2. DUE DILIGENCE AND CLOSING. Before signing, the Seller shall provide the Buyer reasonable access to the Company’s financial, tax, legal, operational, and corporate records, subject to confidentiality protections. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions below.

3. CLOSING CONDITIONS AND SELLER WARRANTIES. The Buyer’s obligation to close is conditional on required approvals being obtained, no law prohibiting the transaction, no material adverse change in the Company, and the Seller’s warranties being true in all material respects at closing. The Seller warrants its authority and title to the Shares; the Company’s due organization, capitalization, and compliance with applicable law; and the accuracy in all material respects of its financial statements and disclosures concerning liabilities, taxes, material contracts, litigation, employees, intellectual property, and assets, in each case subject to agreed disclosure schedules and negotiated qualifications.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to negotiated survival periods, thresholds, caps, and exclusions, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from breaches of the Seller’s warranties or covenants and from liabilities expressly retained by the Seller. The parties shall agree procedures for notice, defense, and settlement of third-party claims.
